sentences.en: Situated on a hill, his house commands a fine view.
sentences.zh: 他的房子位于山上，可以俯瞰美丽的景色。

sentences.en: The same sentence could have the force of a command.
sentences.zh: 同样的句子也可以被理解为一种命令。

sentences.en: It is essential to have good command of English nowadays.
sentences.zh: 如今掌握良好的英语是非常重要的。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：com（加强）+mand（命令）→命令
